Initial release — convert photo collections into shareable slideshow videos using AI cloud rendering.

- Supports JPG, PNG, WEBP, HEIC (up to 200MB) and outputs 1080p MP4 videos in about 30–60 seconds.
- Automatic backend connection with seamless token setup (100 free credits for new users).
- Upload images, describe your video, and export with support for aspect ratio, text overlays, and audio tracks.
- Credit balance and status checks available; detailed error codes for common issues.
- Optimized for marketers and social media creators seeking quick, polished video slideshows.
